limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses primary progenitor stem cells from zebrafish blastula stage embryos; generalizability to other cell types or organisms is not fully established.
Maximal threshold deformation of ~30% of initial cell diameter before cell lysis limits the range of deformations studied.
Residual myosin II activation in cPLA2 morphant embryos suggests maternal contribution of cPLA2 protein not targeted by MO interference.
The study does not directly measure cPLA2 enzymatic activity at the INM, but infers it from AA production and inhibitor effects.
Long-term effects (>60 min) of nuclear deformation and INM unfolding on cell behavior were not explored beyond the stated stability period.
The role of other potential mechanosensitive pathways or parallel signaling modules was not exhaustively tested.
